local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--//==================================================
--// SETTINGS
--//==================================================

local messages = {}

local autoRandomEnabled = false
local AUTO_RANDOM_DELAY = 5
local lastRandomIndex = nil

local uiScale = 1
local transparency = 0

local accentColor = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 62)

-- Floating quick sentences
local quickSentencesEnabled = true
local quickConfig = {}
-- quickConfig["message"] = {
--     x = number,
--     y = number,
--     locked = boolean
-- }

local quickFrames = {}
local quickDragConnections = {}

local SAVE_FILE = "ChatSenderYe_Messages.json"
local SETTINGS_FILE = "ChatSenderYe_Settings.json"

--//==================================================
--// REMOVE OLD GUI IF SCRIPT IS RAN AGAIN
--//==================================================

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ChatSenderYe_UPD")

if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

--//==================================================
--// FILE FUNCTIONS
--//==================================================

local function loadMessages()
	if isfile and readfile and isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
		local success, data = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
		end)

		if success and type(data) == "table" then
			messages = {}

			for _, message in ipairs(data) do
				if type(message) == "string" and message ~= "" then
					table.insert(messages, message)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function saveMessages()
	if writefile then
		pcall(function()
			writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(messages))
		end)
	end
end

local function loadSettings()
	if isfile and readfile and isfile(SETTINGS_FILE) then
		local success, data = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SETTINGS_FILE))
		end)

		if success and type(data) == "table" then

			if tonumber(data.uiScale) then
				uiScale = math.clamp(tonumber(data.uiScale), 0.7, 1.4)
			end

			if tonumber(data.transparency) then
				transparency = math.clamp(tonumber(data.transparency), 0, 0.7)
			end

			if type(data.quickSentencesEnabled) == "boolean" then
				quickSentencesEnabled = data.quickSentencesEnabled
			end

			if type(data.quickConfig) == "table" then
				quickConfig = {}

				for message, config in pairs(data.quickConfig) do
					if type(message) == "string" and type(config) == "table" then

						quickConfig[message] = {
							x = tonumber(config.x) or 10,
							y = tonumber(config.y) or 150,
							locked = config.locked == true
						}

					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function saveSettings()
	if writefile then
		pcall(function()
			writefile(
				SETTINGS_FILE,
				HttpService:JSONEncode({
					uiScale = uiScale,
					transparency = transparency,
					quickSentencesEnabled = quickSentencesEnabled,
					quickConfig = quickConfig
				})
			)
		end)
	end
end

loadMessages()
loadSettings()

--//==================================================
--// HELPERS
--//==================================================

local function messageExists(message)
	for _, savedMessage in ipairs(messages) do
		if savedMessage == message then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function getDefaultQuickPosition(index)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	local x = 10
	local y = 120 + ((index - 1) * 50)

	if camera then
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

		if y > viewport.Y - 55 then
			y = 100
		end
	end

	return x, y
end

local function clampQuickPosition(frame, x, y)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return x, y
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

	local maxX = math.max(0, viewport.X - frame.AbsoluteSize.X)
	local maxY = math.max(0, viewport.Y - frame.AbsoluteSize.Y)

	return math.clamp(x, 0, maxX),
		math.clamp(y, 0, maxY)
end

--//==================================================
--// SEND MESSAGE
--//==================================================

local function sendMessage(message)
	if not message or message == "" then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		local channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")

		if channels then
			local general = channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

			if general then
				general:SendAsync(message)
			end
		end
	end)
end

--//==================================================
--// MAIN DRAG FUNCTION
--//==================================================

local function makeDraggable(object, dragArea)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPosition

	dragArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPosition = object.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		object.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

--//==================================================

	if connections then
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
	end

	quickDragConnections[frame] = nil
end

--//==================================================
--// CREATE FLOATING QUICK SENTENCE
--//==================================================

createQuickMini = function(message, index)
	if not quickSentencesEnabled then
		return
	end

	if not quickConfig[message] then
		local x, y = getDefaultQuickPosition(index)

		quickConfig[message] = {
			x = x,
			y = y,
			locked = false
		}

		saveSettings()
	end

	local config = quickConfig[message]

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Quick_" .. tostring(index)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 42)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
		config.x or 10,
		config.y or 120
	)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(transparency, 0, 0.7)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Active = true
	frame.ZIndex = 30
	frame.Parent = gui

	Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

	quickFrames[message] = frame

	-- Sentence button

	local sendButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	sendButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 1, 0)
	sendButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	sendButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sendButton.Text = message
	sendButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
	sendButton.TextSize = 13
	sendButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	sendButton.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	sendButton.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	sendButton.ZIndex = 31
	sendButton.Parent = frame

	local textPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	textPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
	textPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
	textPadding.Parent = sendButton

	-- Lock

	local lockButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	lockButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 34)
	lockButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 4)
	lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
	lockButton.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
	lockButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lockButton.Text = config.locked and "🔒" or "🔓"
	lockButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235)
	lockButton.TextSize = 14
	lockButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	lockButton.ZIndex = 32
	lockButton.Parent = frame

	Instance.new("UICorner", lockButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

	-- Remove floating button

	local removeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	removeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 34)
	removeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 4)
	removeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
	removeButton.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
	removeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	removeButton.Text = "×"
	removeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80)
	removeButton.TextSize = 19
	removeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	removeButton.ZIndex = 32
	removeButton.Parent = frame

	Instance.new("UICorner", removeButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

	-- Send

	sendButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		sendMessage(message)
	end)

	-- Lock/unlock

	lockButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		config.locked = not config.locked

		if config.locked then
			lockButton.Text = "🔒"
		else
			lockButton.Text = "🔓"
		end

		saveSettings()
	end)

	-- Remove floating version only

	removeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		quickConfig[message] = nil

		clearQuickDragConnections(frame)

		quickFrames[message] = nil

		frame:Destroy()

		saveSettings()
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- DRAGGING
	--==================================================

	local dragging = false
	local dragInput = nil
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPosition = nil

	local c1 = sendButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if config.locked then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPosition = frame.Position
		end
	end)

	local c2 = sendButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	local c3 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if input ~= dragInput then
			return
		end

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		local newX = startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
		local newY = startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

		newX, newY = clampQuickPosition(frame, newX, newY)

		frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
	end)

	local c4 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = false

			config.x = frame.Position.X.Offset
			config.y = frame.Position.Y.Offset

			saveSettings()
		end
	end)

	quickDragConnections[frame] = {
		c1,
		c2,
		c3,
		c4
	}
end

--//==================================================
--// REFRESH ALL FLOATING QUICK SENTENCES
--//==================================================

refreshQuickMinis = function()
	-- Remove old floating buttons

	for message, frame in pairs(quickFrames) do
		clearQuickDragConnections(frame)

		if frame then
			frame:Destroy()
		end

		quickFrames[message] = nil
	end

	if not quickSentencesEnabled then
		return
	end

	local seen = {}
	local index = 0

	for _, message in ipairs(messages) do
		if quickConfig[message] and not seen[message] then
			seen[message] = true
			index += 1

			createQuickMini(message, index)
		end
	end
end

--//==================================================
--// REFRESH SAVED MESSAGE LIST
--//==================================================

refreshMessages = function()
	for _, child in ipairs(messageScroll:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for index, message in ipairs(messages) do

		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 42)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 40)
		row.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
		row.BorderSizePixel = 0
		row.LayoutOrder = index
		row.ZIndex = 12
		row.Parent = messageScroll

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	warn("TowerHub must run as a LocalScript.")
	return
end

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 15)

if not playerGui then
	warn("TowerHub: PlayerGui was not found.")
	return
end

print("TowerHub: script started")

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TowerHub")

if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

--==================================================
-- FIND UNIT / TOWER FOLDERS
--==================================================

local folderNames = {
	tower = true,
	towers = true,

	unit = true,
	units = true,

	troop = true,
	troops = true,

	character = true,
	characters = true,

	npc = true,
	npcs = true,

	unitsfolder = true,
	towerfolder = true,
}

local function isUnitTowerFolder(object)
	return object:IsA("Folder")
		and folderNames[object.Name:lower()] == true
end

local function getAllUnitsAndTowers()
	local objects = {}
	local seen = {}

	for _, folder in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
		if isUnitTowerFolder(folder) then
			for _, object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if not seen[object] then
					seen[object] = true
					table.insert(objects, object)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(objects, function(a, b)
		return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
	end)

	return objects
end

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "TowerHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 999
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Parent = playerGui

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
main.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(560, 400)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 18, 24)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Visible = true
main.Parent = gui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
mainCorner.Parent = main

local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
mainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(62, 65, 80)
mainStroke.Thickness = 1
mainStroke.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- RESPONSIVE SCALE
--==================================================

local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
uiScale.Scale = 1
uiScale.Parent = main

local function updateScale()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local width = viewport.X
	local height = viewport.Y

	local scaleX = (width - 20) / 560
	local scaleY = (height - 20) / 400
	local screenScale = math.min(scaleX, scaleY)

	if width <= 390 then
		uiScale.Scale = math.min(screenScale, 0.82)
	elseif width <= 600 then
		uiScale.Scale = math.min(screenScale, 0.90)
	else
		uiScale.Scale = math.min(screenScale, 1)
	end

	if uiScale.Scale <= 0 then
		uiScale.Scale = 0.5
	end
end

local function connectCamera()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateScale)
	updateScale()
end

connectCamera()

workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
	task.defer(connectCamera)
end)

--==================================================
-- TOP BAR

local function readValueObject(object)
	if object:IsA("NumberValue")
		or object:IsA("IntValue")
		or object:IsA("StringValue")
		or object:IsA("BoolValue") then

		return object.Value
	end

	return nil
end

local function findStatInObject(object, statName)
	if not object then
		return nil
	end

	local attribute = object:GetAttribute(statName)

	if attribute ~= nil then
		return attribute
	end

	local direct = object:FindFirstChild(statName)

	if direct then
		local value = readValueObject(direct)

		if value ~= nil then
			return value
		end
	end

	for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
		local child = object:FindFirstChild(alias)

		if child then
			local value = readValueObject(child)

			if value ~= nil then
				return value
			end
		end

		local attr = object:GetAttribute(alias)

		if attr ~= nil then
			return attr
		end
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
		local attr = descendant:GetAttribute(statName)

		if attr ~= nil then
			return attr
		end

		local value = readValueObject(descendant)

		if value ~= nil then
			if descendant.Name:lower() == statName:lower() then
				return value
			end

			for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
				if descendant.Name:lower() == alias:lower() then
					return value
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function findStatInModule(moduleScript, statName)
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return nil
	end

	local success, data = pcall(require, moduleScript)

	if not success or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	if data[statName] ~= nil then
		return data[statName]
	end

	for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
		if data[alias] ~= nil then
			return data[alias]
		end
	end

	for key, value in pairs(data) do
		if type(key) == "string" then
			if key:lower() == statName:lower() then
				return value
			end

			for _, alias in ipairs(aliases[statName] or {}) do
				if key:lower() == alias:lower() then
					return value
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function findStat(unit, statName)
	local result = findStatInObject(unit, statName)

	if result ~= nil then
		return result
	end

	for _, configName in ipairs({
		"Config",
		"Configuration",
		"Stats",
		"Data",
		"TowerData",
		"UnitData"
	}) do

		local config = unit:FindFirstChild(configName)

		if config then
			result = findStatInObject(config, statName)

			if result ~= nil then
				return result
			end
		end
	end

	for _, object in ipairs(unit:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			result = findStatInModule(object, statName)

			if result ~= nil then
				return result
			end
		end
	end

	return "N/A"
end

local function calculateDPS(unit)
	local directDPS = findStat(unit, "DPS")

	if directDPS ~= "N/A" then
		return directDPS
	end

	local damage = findStat(unit, "Damage")
	local cooldown = findStat(unit, "Cooldown")

	if type(damage) == "number"
		and type(cooldown) == "number"
		and cooldown > 0 then

		return math.round((damage / cooldown) * 100) / 100
	end

	return "N/A"
end

local function isInsideUnitTowerFolder(object)
	local current = object

	while current and current ~= ReplicatedStorage do
		if isUnitTowerFolder(current) then
			return true
		end

		current = current.Parent
	end

	return false
end

end)

local function findSpawnRemote()
	local containers = {}

	local functionsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Functions")

	if functionsFolder then
		table.insert(containers, functionsFolder)
	end

	local remoteFunctions = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunctions")

	if remoteFunctions then
		table.insert(containers, remoteFunctions)
	end

	local remoteEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvents")

	if remoteEvents then
		table.insert(containers, remoteEvents)
	end

	table.insert(containers, ReplicatedStorage)

	for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
		for _, wantedName in ipairs(spawnNames) do
			local remote = container:FindFirstChild(wantedName, true)

			if remote
				and (
					remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")
					or remote:IsA("RemoteEvent")
				) then

				return remote
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

spawnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not selectedUnitName then
		selectedTitle.Text = "SELECT A UNIT OR TOWER"
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		character = player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		selectedTitle.Text = "CHARACTER NOT READY"
		return
	end

	local spawnRemote = findSpawnRemote()

	if not spawnRemote then
		warn("No tower/unit spawn RemoteFunction or RemoteEvent was found.")
		selectedTitle.Text = "SPAWN REMOTE NOT FOUND"
		return
	end

	local success, result = pcall(function()
		if spawnRemote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
			return spawnRemote:InvokeServer(
				selectedUnitName,
				root.CFrame
			)

		elseif spawnRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			spawnRemote:FireServer(
				selectedUnitName,
				root.CFrame
			)

			return true
		end
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("Spawn request failed:", result)
		selectedTitle.Text = "SPAWN REQUEST FAILED"
	else
		print(
			"Spawn request sent:",
			spawnRemote:GetFullName(),
			selectedUnitName
		)
	end
end)

local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPosition = nil
local dragInput = nil

top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

top.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false
		dragInput = nil
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		return
	end

	if not dragStart or not startPosition then
		return
	end

	local delta = input.Position - dragStart

	main.Position = UDim2.new(
		startPosition.X.Scale,
		startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
		startPosition.Y.Scale,
		startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	)
end)
